rationale: UK sanctions on Israeli settlements and Israel's consulate closure mark a new EU-Middle East diplomatic rupture; Canada tariff war continues as background; Kyiv drone strike is another continuation of known conflict.

top_events.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
top_events.label: UK sanctions Israeli settlements, Israel shuts consulate
top_events.summary: Britain bans settlement goods and accuses settlers of ethnic cleansing; Israel closes UK consulate in East Jerusalem in retaliation. New EU-Israel diplomatic rupture.

top_events.title: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
top_events.label: Russian drone kills five in Kyiv TV building
top_events.summary: Daytime drone strike hits Ukrainian capital's TV channel building, killing five. Continuation of known Russian air campaign against Kyiv infrastructure.

top_events.title: Canada's retaliatory US tariffs take effect as trade dispute grows
top_events.label: Canada retaliatory tariffs on US goods take effect
top_events.summary: Canadian tariffs up to 50% on $20bn US products now active, covering steel to textiles. Trade war escalation continues as known background.

short_summary: AfD wins 44% in German state election

most_significant_event.label: AfD wins 44% in German state election
most_significant_event.summary: Far-right party projected to win Saxony-Anhalt with 44%, far ahead of conservatives at 17%. First far-right state government in Germany since WWII shifts EU political landscape.
most_significant_event.title: Germany's far-right AfD set for big win in eastern state, just short of majority
